text.en: Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space lies our freedom.
text.ko: 자극과 반응 사이에는 공간이 있다. 그 공간에 우리의 자유가 있다.
text.zh-cn: 在刺激与回应之间存在一段距离，成长与自由的关键正在那里。
text.fr: Entre la stimulation et la réponse, il y a un espace. Dans cet espace se trouve notre liberté.

moral.en: The gap was always there. I just never stood in it.
moral.ko: 그 틈은 늘 거기 있었다. 나는 거기 서 본 적이 없다.

scenes.image_prompt: empty corridor at dawn, long shadows on the floor, wide shot

narration.en: Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space lies our freedom. — Viktor Frankl.
narration.ko: 자극과 반응 사이에는 공간이 있다. 그 공간에 우리의 자유가 있다. — 빅터 프랭클.
narration.zh-cn: 刺激与反应之间，有一段空隙。那段空隙里，有我们的自由。

scenes.image_prompt: narrow apartment hallway at night, coat half off, distant figure, long shot

narration.en: The words come out first. The regret comes after
narration.ko: 말이 먼저 나온다. 후회는 그 뒤에 온다
narration.zh-cn: 话先出口。后悔跟在后面。
narration.fr: Les mots sortent d'abord. Le regret vient après.

scenes.image_prompt: narrow alley at dawn, bicycle leaning on a wall, small figure walking away, wide shot

narration.en: I slammed the door and walked into the alley.
narration.zh-cn: 我用力关上门，走进小巷。
narration.fr: J'ai claqué la porte et je suis sorti dans la ruelle.

scenes.image_prompt: stairwell landing in the afternoon, dust in the light, figure sitting on steps, wide shot

narration.en: I sat on the stairs and deleted the message three times.
narration.ko: 계단참에 앉아 답장을 세 번 지웠다.
narration.zh-cn: 我坐在楼梯上，删了三遍回信。
narration.fr: Assis sur les marches, j'ai effacé le message trois fois.

scenes.image_prompt: bus stop at dusk, empty bench, distant figure standing, wide shot

narration.en: At the bus stop I let two buses go by.
narration.ko: 정류장에서 버스 두 대를 그냥 보냈다.
narration.zh-cn: 在车站，我放走了两班车。
narration.fr: À l'arrêt, j'ai laissé passer deux bus.

scenes.image_prompt: small kitchen at night, one glass on the counter, figure by the sink, seen from behind

narration.en: In the kitchen I drank a glass of water before I spoke.
narration.ko: 부엌에서 물 한 컵을 마시고 말했다.
narration.zh-cn: 在厨房喝完一杯水，我才开口。
narration.fr: Dans la cuisine, j'ai bu un verre d'eau avant de parler.

scenes.image_prompt: desk by a window late at night, one apple and a dark lamp, seen from behind

narration.en: I put an apple on the desk and turned off the light.
narration.ko: 책상 위에 사과 하나를 놓고 불을 껐다.
narration.zh-cn: 我在桌上放了一个苹果，关灯。
narration.fr: J'ai posé une pomme sur le bureau et éteint la lampe.

scenes.image_prompt: office window in the afternoon, blinds half open, figure standing still, seen from behind

narration.en: Before he answers, he looks out the window.
narration.zh-cn: 回答之前，他看了一眼窗外。
narration.fr: Avant de répondre, il regarde par la fenêtre.

narration.zh-cn: 此刻，那段空隙也在眼前。
narration.fr: Ce vide est devant moi, maintenant.
